bsk: bsk — entrails, innards, viscera (noun; plural bskw)
bꜣby: bꜣby — Babi, a savage baboon god who devours the condemned (god's name; Budge: Baabi)
hri: hri — to be content, pleased, satisfied (with: ḥr) (verb; relative form hrrt 'that with which one is pleased')
iby: iby — thirsty; the thirsty man (adjective, noun; from ib 'be thirsty')
ind: ind — hail! greetings! (interjection, from i 'O' and nḏ ḥr 'greet the face'; ind ḥr·k 'hail to you')
ip: ip — to count, reckon, assess (verb); ipt 'reckoning, assessment' (noun)
ipw: ipw — these (plural demonstrative, after its noun)
itn: itn — the disk of the sun, the Aten (noun)
iwty: iwty — who has not, without (negative relative adjective, the opposite of nty)
iwy: iwy — boatless, one who has no boat (noun)
išd: išd — the persea tree, sacred tree of Heliopolis (noun)
m-bꜣḥ: m-bꜣḥ — in the presence of, before (compound preposition: m 'in' + bꜣḥ 'front')
m-ḫt: m-ḫt — after, behind, in the following of (compound preposition: m 'in' + ḫt 'rear')
m-ꜥ: m-ꜥ — from (the hand of); with, in the keeping of (compound preposition: m 'in' + ꜥ 'hand')
mdt: mdt — word, speech, matter (noun; from mdw 'speak')
mri: mri — to love, wish, desire (verb; relative form mrrt·f, mrt·f 'what he loves, what he desires')
mtr: mtr — to bear witness, testify (verb); witness (noun; plural mtrw)
nb-r-ḏr: nb-r-ḏr — 'the Lord to the Limit', the Lord of All, a name of the creator god (god's name; Budge: Neb-er-tcher)
nn: nn — not, there is not (negative particle; nn + noun 'there is no …'; nn + sḏm·f 'will not …'; in later copies also written for n)
prt-ḫrw: prt-ḫrw — invocation-offering, 'the going forth of the voice': offerings called into being by the spoken offering formula (noun)
psš: psš — to divide, split, share out (verb); division, splitting (noun)
pwy: pwy — this, that (masculine demonstrative, after its noun; hrw pwy 'that day')
smi: smi — to report, announce; to accuse (verb; smi r 'report against')
sn: sn — two (numeral; sp sn 'twice', written after a word to be said twice)
sp: sp — time, occasion; deed, case, matter (noun); sp sn 'twice'
sr: sr — official, magistrate, noble (noun; plural srw)
sw: sw — he, him, it (3rd person masculine singular dependent pronoun)
sḥtp: sḥtp — to make content, satisfy, appease (verb; causative of ḥtp 'be content')
sꜥm: sꜥm — to swallow, gulp down, consume (verb)
sꜥr: sꜥr — to make go up, bring up; to report, present (a matter) to a superior (verb; causative of ꜥr 'go up')
tn: tn — you (2nd person plural dependent pronoun, object of a verb or subject after nty; older spelling ṯn)
twy: twy — this, that (feminine demonstrative, after its noun)
wi: wi — me (1st person singular dependent pronoun, object of a verb)
wy: wy — how …! (admirative particle after a verb or adjective; iy wy 'welcome!')
wḏꜥ: wḏꜥ — to judge, separate (verb); wḏꜥ(w)t 'judgement, decision' (noun)
wꜥb: wꜥb — pure, clean; to be pure (adjective, verb; the sign of water poured over a foot)
·s: ·s — she, her, it (3rd person feminine singular suffix pronoun; also neuter 'it')
·tw: ·tw — one, someone (impersonal suffix; makes a passive: ḏd·tw 'one says, it is said')
šn: šn — to revile, curse (? verb; reading and sense uncertain, perhaps for šnṯ 'revile')
šꜥt: šꜥt — slaughter, massacre; the slaughtering (noun; from šꜥd 'cut')
ḏw: ḏw — evil, bad; an evil deed (adjective, noun; written with the mountain ḏw)
ḥpd-rꜣ: ḥpd-rꜣ — 'Open of Mouth'(?), a god in whose house the donkey and the cat speak (god's name; reading uncertain; Budge: Hept-re)
ḥqr: ḥqr — hungry; the hungry man (adjective, noun; from ḥqr 'be hungry')
ḥr-ntt: ḥr-ntt — because (conjunction: ḥr 'on account of' + ntt 'that')
ḥꜣwt: ḥꜣwt — innards, entrails (? noun; reading uncertain, written with the intestine as classifier)
ḥꜣy: ḥꜣy — naked; the naked man (adjective, noun; from ḥꜣi 'be naked')
ḫbnt: ḫbnt — crime, wrongdoing, guilt (noun; from ḫbn 'be guilty')
ẖnw: ẖnw — interior, inside, residence (noun; m ẖnw 'within')
